notes.title: Busy Few Weeks
notes.content:
It has been a full month sine Meiro Master was released. 

The community have been absolutely perfect and have offered so much support and feedback.

Feedback is so vital to us to make sure that improvements are made. Over the last couple of weeks, the following patch updates have been made to make improvements to gameplay:

 Brand new dialogue graphics- it was said that the graphics for the dialogue system was basic. Now they are a brand new design with more style and colour.


 Updates to the design of levels- some of the Meiro maze levels were plain with basic colours. Now these levels have been updated to match the overall style of Meiro master.


 More animals added- you wanted more animals so now you have more animals to interact with.


Again the success of Meiro Master would not be possible without our fantastic fans. Thank you and keep an eye on further patch updates because we have many more planned!!
